spec_family.name: Residential Wall Repaint — Finish Coats (SF Field + LF Edges)
spec_family.description: Finish coats for previously painted walls in residential repaint. Models field work as SF and edge/cut-line work as LF using PaintScope-derived geometry. Supports freehand cut-in (typical) and tape-line edge strategies. Includes condition-based prep variants for good and fair condition surfaces. Roll application only.

wall_sf.description: Total paintable wall square footage (perimeter × height minus openings per policy)

ceiling_line_lf.description: Linear feet of wall-to-ceiling cut line

trim_line_lf.description: Linear feet of wall-to-baseboard/trim cut line

opening_casing_lf.description: Linear feet of wall-to-opening casing cut line (doors, windows)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier affects sanding, inspection, and edge discipline.
Condition of existing painted surface affects prep intensity.
How edges are produced at ceiling and trim lines.
Wall sheen affects visibility of defects and technique requirements.
Magnitude of color change affects coverage and discipline.
Ceiling height affects access and edge work productivity.

paintable_items.name: Residential Wall Field Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Wall field area in square feet from PaintScope (perimeter × height minus openings).
paintable_items.notes: Previously painted latex or alkyd surface.

paintable_items.name: Residential Wall Edge / Cut Line Length
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear feet of cut lines at ceiling, baseboard, and openings from PaintScope.
paintable_items.notes: Includes ceiling line, trim line, and opening casing line.

variants.name: Good Condition + Freehand Cut-in
variants.notes: Standard residential repaint: minimal prep, freehand cut-in.

variants.name: Good Condition + Tape Line
variants.notes: Premium residential: tape-line for crisp edges on color contrast jobs.

variants.name: Fair Condition + Freehand Cut-in
variants.notes: Extended prep for moderate wear; freehand cut-in.

variants.name: Fair Condition + Tape Line
variants.notes: Extended prep + tape-line for premium fair condition jobs.

assumptions: Existing paint is latex or compatible alkyd; lead paint testing is out of scope.
Walls are structurally sound; major drywall repair is excluded.
PaintScope provides room geometry to compute wall SF and edge LF.
Standard residential ceiling height (8-10ft); factors apply for higher ceilings.
Occupied home with furniture; protection setup/teardown included.
exclusions: Trim, door, and window painting (separate specs)
Major drywall repair beyond spackle and caulk
Spray application (roll only in this spec)

change_log.author: SpecFactory
